scope: Computational closure of the EUR/CHF branch: the EBS book calibration for the pair and the episode of 15 January 2015. Manuscript prose is outside this protocol.

revision_history.reason: Calm endogenous dealer activation was 19/300 and its Wilson upper 95% bound exceeded 5%; all literature and book-lifecycle gates passed.

changes: AMM support remains a quoting diagnostic but is no longer a calm-market additive dealer-exit intercept.
Full endogenous dealer withdrawal requires two consecutive above-threshold observations; the first observation immediately makes quotes defensive.
All bank dealers receive exchangeable equal-price queue priority from a dedicated paired-invariant scheduler stream.
revision_history.holdout_note: Run on seeds 10042 to 10341 and passed with zero gating and zero mechanism failures, calm activation 0.0033 and an EBS seed pass rate of 0.963. The phase status field was never updated from untouched_single_use_holdout, so the manifest claimed a holdout that had in fact been spent. Those seeds are now seen and cannot serve as a holdout again.

revision_history.reason: Every frozen hash changed, so v2 could authorise nothing. The rotation is recorded and not performed quietly, because a protocol that is reissued whenever it becomes inconvenient is not a commitment device. The holdout seeds have still never been evaluated and the commitment is carried across unchanged.
changes: price_tick declared at the EBS increment; it had been a constructor default and the single largest determinant of the quoted spread.
A dealer or fast provider quote that would cross the book now trades instead of being clamped behind the touch.
A resting dealer quote is withdrawn once the price has come inside a fraction of the spread that dealer would quote now.
Book fundamentalists read the latent value with noise and quote around it, so price discovery is carried by participants and not by repricing anonymous orders.
fast_lp_vol_multiple declared and calibrated jointly with the constant part of the quote; the spread now responds to volatility with an elasticity of 0.285 against 0.11 before.
Dealer capacity contagion added, inert below a threshold and convex above it after BIS Working Paper 1138. A gain of zero reproduces the previous model and the regression fingerprint confirms it.

funding_spread_comovement_sign demoted from a gate to a diagnostic after its power was measured at zero: the model passes it at a funding coefficient of zero and at minus ten times the calibrated magnitude.
Touch depth and the order-flow persistence band demoted to diagnostics; the band had been read from a column of Wald statistics.
Spread target restated on the published annual average for 2025 and not a favourable slice of 2024.
price_discovery_half_life_ticks added as a gate, measured in the crisis scenario.

Signature keys no longer include __module__. The same source tree produced two different signatures depending on whether a module was imported or run with python -m, so a protocol frozen one way refused the identical code run the other way.

mm_softlimit declared and raised from 100 to 200. The inventory term alone was reaching the withdrawal threshold on calm paths, because the limit had been left at the value it carried when the dealer held a single unit.
Holdout seed commitment moved to 20042, since the 10042 block was spent under v2.

The per-seed EBS pass rate was demoted from a gate to a diagnostic. It gated dispersion, not centring, which the panel targets already cover, and neither its 0.90 threshold nor the band behind it has a source. It had read as satisfied because it was measuring a defect: with the quote-life cap set to the published 290 seconds and an anti-crossing rule preventing dealers taking each other, every dealer order ended on its timer and the per-seed median clung to the cap, giving a p5-p95 span of 55 seconds and 99.3 per cent inside the band. With quotes able to trade the statistic is better centred, 292 against a target of 290 where v2 gave 268.5, and disperses over 141 seconds, so 83.7 per cent sit inside.
revision_history.version_note: Numbered v4 and not v3. The string book-lp-final-v3 is reserved in tools/robustness/lp_acceptance.py as DIRECT_PROTOCOL_VERSION, where it selects a stricter direct-acceptance contract that forbids a historical amendment and requires the LP signatures to be frozen directly. This rotation does not satisfy that contract, so taking the name would have claimed a guarantee it does not provide.

revision_history.reason: The crisis scenario the panel audits is now the identified March 2020 episode. The synthetic preset it replaced evacuated the whole dealer sector on every seed, so the mechanism checks were reading a scripted outcome. The holdout block moves to 20042 because 10042 was evaluated under v2 and is spent.
changes: dash_for_cash_2020 and dealer_capacity_contagion added as identified EUR/USD episodes with sustained stress.

Episode stress persists over the window. At the decay the synthetic presets carried, a half life near 13 seconds, the stress was gone before dealers reacted: friction while dealer capacity was impaired measured 0.064, against 0.718 once the half life is near 230 seconds.

The contagion channel multiplies existing friction instead of adding a term of its own. The additive level form held systemic liquidity at 1/(1+g), under the 0.55 a withdrawn dealer needs to return, and latched the sector out for 586 periods of 1000 against 244 with the channel off.
dealer_capacity_threshold lowered from 0.5 to 0.25, the level the sector reaches without degenerating.
dealer_cascade_gain set to zero: the severity at which the channel becomes measurable is the severity at which the sector evacuates, so no admissible setting both acts and leaves a valid market.
The per-seed EBS pass rate demoted from a gate to a diagnostic.

The dealer response window in the acceptance metrics widened from 60 periods to 150. The window was shorter than the response it measures: impaired capacity reaches 0.56 only by the fortieth period and peaks near the eightieth, so on 300 seeds a 60 period window recorded no withdrawal on 29 per cent of paths where dealers did withdraw later, and crisis activation read 0.707 while the sector responded on nearly every path.
Dealers carry a private internalised client franchise. Without one their inventories correlate 0.961 through the crisis and the sector crosses its withdrawal thresholds together.

simulate is resumable. The tick counter was the loop index and restarted at zero on every call, so a run built by stepping one period at a time never reached the tick the shock is scheduled on and silently produced a shock free path.

The most robust dealer is a core placed above the withdrawal ladder, so a common shock can take at most four dealers of five and a full evacuation is impossible by construction. Every other measured quantity is unchanged.

The contagion gain is 4.0. At 2.0 the multiplier on friction at the median impairment is 1.06 and the channel is not detectable; at 4.0 the effect on 200 paired seeds is +0.17 [+0.01, +0.34] on the peak spread and +18.7 [+6.9, +31.5] on cumulative excess.

Resource matched arms added: a dealer of last resort and a passive book facility holding the same capital and inventory capacity as the reserve priced pool, and a reallocation arm funding the pool out of the dealer sector. All default to the reserve arm at its natural size, which leaves the calibrated model unchanged.

revision_history.reason: The LP block described a scenario and a window the tooling no longer runs, so the manifest documented one experiment while the code ran another. No threshold and no target moved; the target matrix digest is unchanged. A full rotation waits on the resource matched arms.
changes: lp_design.scenario moved from dealer_liquidity_crisis to dash_for_cash_2020, matching the acceptance panel and the welfare tooling.
lp_design.crisis_window_offsets moved from 0-100 to 0-150, matching the resilience comparison and exceeding the minimum time an exit takes to form.
final_inference_panel seed block moved from 10042 to 20042, the earlier block having been spent under v2 while the status field still called it untouched.
pnl_panel and welfare_incidence_panels marked superseded, their results having been produced on the replaced episode.

dealer_cascade_gain stands at 4.0. The v4 note recording it as zero was written before two errors in its measurement were found, an amplitude too weak to register and an unconditional average over a tail effect, and it is superseded and not removed.

revision_history.reason: The model digest claimed to cover only what can change a simulated trajectory and hashed the raw bytes of every module, so an edit to a comment invalidated the provenance of every stored artifact and forced a re-run that could not have produced a different number. It now hashes the token stream with comments and blank lines removed, which is invariant to layout and moves on any executable change. Every frozen digest below is therefore restated; no threshold, target or parameter moved with it.
changes: model_signature hashes executable tokens instead of raw bytes for Python modules.
Retired the chartist, universalist and conditional provider populations, which the calibration held at zero while the paper tabulated them as part of the model.
Retired the per agent collector and the plots that read it, which recorded dividends, sentiments and strategy switching that this market does not have.

The facility arm is excluded from the incumbent dealer aggregate and from the dealer state shares, carries no credit line, opens flat with a short line matched to the pool base reserve, quotes independently of market stress and reprices whenever the mid moves.

The arms outcome is the best executable round trip cost across both venues, which is the outcome the paper declares. Read as the order book spread alone it was pinned by the arms that quote into that book and blind to the arm that is a separate venue.
Added a recovery speed against a level taken from the control, which is the second limb of H1, and a markout of the flow each venue fills, which is H2.

The target matrix digest covers what each target tests and no longer covers the prose recording where it came from, which is the line primary_runtime_sha256 already drew for the model manifest. Rewording a note no longer invalidates a frozen protocol; changing an observable, a band, a gate, a weight or a source still does.

near_touch_depth renamed to near_mid_depth_thin_side. It was named and documented as the quantity resting at the best bid and ask and measured the smaller side within twenty five basis points of the mid, a band of some twenty seven pips, so its realised value read two orders above the touch. It also cited a study of ASX equities for a foreign exchange observable; the source now records that none is identified. The record carries the scale that EBS turnover implies, one base unit near 1.3 million euro, against which the touch holds a few million and is the right order for the venue.

revision_history.reason: This is the EUR/CHF branch of the model. Three quantities differ from the primary pair and no equation does: the quoting increment, taken from the EBS decimal pip at the floor rate of 1.2010; the annual volatility of the latent price, taken from the median annualised realised volatility the pair shows in Table 2 of Mancini, Ranaldo and Wrampelmeyer; and the overnight cost of committed capital, which both legs of this pair carried at a negative policy rate in the episode and which the model therefore floors at zero. The episode is the removal of the Swiss franc floor on 15 January 2015, whose repricing is pinned by the ECB daily reference rate and whose dislocation is checked against the effective spreads of Breedon, Chen, Ranaldo and Vause. Every frozen digest is restated because the target matrix, the runtime and the model all moved with the pair.
changes: price_tick 0.000909 to 0.0008326, price_vol_scale 0.0012859 to 0.001153, funding_rate_scale and amm_lp_outside_option to zero.
n_fast_lp 2 to 1 and fast_lp_base_withdraw_prob 0 to 0.65, so that the bank share of passive volume can reach the 92.9 per cent this pair shows against the 72.6 per cent derived for the primary one.
Episode snb_floor_removal_2015 added and dash_for_cash_2020 retired from the scenario suite.
Crisis gate crisis_spread_multiple added, the first gate on this model that is not a calm state statistic; the spread and maker-share targets repointed to measurements of this pair.
price_discovery_half_life_ticks demoted from gating: its estimate is EUR/USD and no EUR/CHF counterpart was found.
A negative funding rate is refused instead of being clamped to zero in silence.
The sensitivity grid steps the outside option additively where its baseline is zero, since a multiplicative arm collapses onto the baseline there.

revision_history.reason: An external audit found the crisis gate one sided, so a model could dislocate without bound and still pass. A ceiling on the spread multiple is not available, because the study measures effective spreads on trades printed inside the touch while the model reports the touch, and the factor between them in a dislocation is unknown. The episode is instead bounded from above by a second crisis target that needs no conversion at all: the bank share of provided volume, which the same study reports at 93.5 per cent on the event day against 92.9 before it. The model failed that target at a withdrawal threshold of 0.7 and meets it at 3.2, which is the sense in which the episode was a repricing the banks quoted through and not an evacuation of the dealer sector.
changes: Crisis target dealer_maker_volume_share added on the episode scenario, two sided, from Table 1 of the episode study; it bounds the dislocation from above.
Episode mm_withdraw_threshold 0.7 to 3.2, calibrated against that target on a forty seed panel; every stored result moves with it.
Calm quoted spread target changed from the converted point of 1.02 to the interval [1.02, 1.80] the two available readings of this pair bracket, so the conversion is no longer load bearing.
The chronology of the two policy legs corrected: the Swiss leg stood at zero on the day, since the announced -0.25 per cent took effect on 22 January 2015.
fast_lp_base_withdraw_prob note corrected to the value the calibration carries.
welfare_accounting takes an outside-option override so the zero cost of capital can be bounded by measurement.
A width regression for the obliged quoter added under a one per cent displacement.
Regression baseline shifts attributed to parameters by ablation and recorded in the file.

revision_history.reason: Two of the branch's gates were answered by something other than what they asked about, and the price grid the branch declares was not the one the model quoted on. The crisis share of provided volume was measured over the whole run, so a gate written on the event day was answered mostly by the days before it. The dealer withdrawal threshold had been set against that diluted figure, and the share of provided volume cannot see a period in which nothing executes: at 3.2 the dealer sector stood fully withdrawn for a median of 86 periods of 150 and no passive volume executed at all on 636 of 640 such periods across eight seeds. The book was not thin then, it was dark. Separately, round_price snapped each price to the declared increment and then rounded the result to three decimals, which is a coarser grid: not one quoted price in any run was a multiple of the 0.0008326 the manifest names, and the increment the branch derives from the EBS decimal pip had no effect on any quote. Every frozen digest moves, and every stored result moves with them.
changes: Episode mm_withdraw_threshold 3.2 to 4.0. At 4.0 the sector never empties and withdrawal remains the dominant mechanism, with 68 per cent of dealers withdrawn at the peak. The liquidity shock does not govern this, moving the count of dark periods from 80 to 78 across its whole range; the threshold does.

Crisis dealer_maker_volume_share re-scoped from the whole run to the repricing onward, which is the event day the source reports. The same run reads 0.898 whole, 0.865 on the event day and 0.926 before it.

The calm reading of the same statistic moved off the shockless scenario and onto the episode's own pre-shock segment, as dealer_maker_volume_share_pre_event. Both rows of the source's Table 1 are now taken from one run, one from each side of the repricing, as the source takes them from one venue.

The response window is reported for this statistic and is not gated. Over it the model reads 0.975, outside the band: its single non-bank provider prices off a reference that leads the lagging book, so through a repricing it crosses and takes instead of resting. Sweeping how often that provider is present, across its whole range, moves the figure from 0.996 to 0.975 and never into the band, so the miss is structural.

The per-seed EBS panel counted four checks where it should have counted five: the calm and crisis readings of the maker share shared one observable name, so the status dictionary kept whichever was written last and one row of the source table was never read.

round_price, floor_price and ceil_price no longer re-round to three decimals after snapping to the tick. The declared increment is now the grid. The calm mean quoted spread falls from 1.069 to 1.021 basis points on the 300 seed development block as a result.

The bound on the non-bank lifetime atom share becomes a bound on the share of the seed panel that complies, at 95 per cent, in place of a bound on every seed. The bound exists so that a median order lifetime is not assembled out of orders opened and closed inside one period, and that purpose survives a tail.

dealer_full_withdrawal_ticks added: how long the sector stands fully withdrawn, and not merely whether it ever does. A peak of one says the book emptied; only the duration says whether it emptied for a moment or stayed empty.

A third reading recorded against the calm spread target: Huang, Ranaldo, Schrimpf and Somogyi give a mean relative bid-ask spread for EUR/CHF on EBS of 1.71 basis points over calendar 2016, measured directly. It is not made a bound, because it falls inside the interval in force and its year is one of free float. It settles the objection that the interval is too wide to constrain anything: both direct readings of this pair sit at 1.7 to 1.8 and only the converted one sits at 1.02, so the interval is the distance between a pegged regime and a floating one.

tools/robustness/spread_identification.py added, which moves each candidate parameter on its own and reads the calm spread, so that what identifies that spread is a measurement in the record and not a claim.

The article claims tool read a scenario name this branch no longer carries, so one row of the calibration table was dropped in silence while the tool reported a pass. It reads the identified episode now.

H4 moved onto the annual frame. On the crisis window an outside option of a hundred basis points a year is five hundredths of a quote unit against an operating loss of ten thousand, so the hypothesis could not be tested there at all. tools/robustness/participation_grid.py measures the crisis-state share of windows at which the provider stops covering itself, over a grid of outside options and sponsor transfers, and reads the same share against a milder and a more severe episode.

The break-even share that grid computes carries the opportunity cost of the capital, which the one already in the record does not, and it works in rates per second. The stored share divides a calm window of a hundred seconds by the sum of itself and a crisis window of a hundred and fifty, which compares unequal windows, and it is taken before the opportunity cost, which is the whole of the channel H4 names, so it could not have moved with the outside option whatever the model did.
welfare_accounting.annual_frame had no caller anywhere in the tree. It has one now.

The fallback episode named when the manifest cannot be read was dash_for_cash_2020, an episode of the primary pair. On this branch that is the outcome the function refuses in its own docstring: the wrong episode measured against the wrong crisis targets, silently. It is a sentinel now, which names no episode, so the module imports and nothing runs on it.
identify and participation added to the entry point and to the README, so that every measurement the manuscript rests on is reachable the same way as the rest.

The two constants that match the arms on resources were re-read on the corrected grid, since the pool they match was priced on the increment the model actually used. The capital the reserve priced pool holds moves from 899,087 to 898,332, and its own round trip at the outcome size from 2.294 to 2.3011 basis points. The 2.294 was set from three seeds and the twenty seed check recorded beside it belonged to the superseded grid; the value now carried is the mean over twenty seeds of two hundred pre-shock periods each, with a standard error of 0.0024.

The calm and crisis windows are now the same length. The crisis window was lengthened to a hundred and fifty periods and the calm window was left at a hundred, so every comparison of the two states divided a gain earned over one span into a loss taken over another and the count of calm windows one crisis window consumes was overstated by about half. The calm window is a hundred and fifty periods now, running from the end of the provider warm up, which is three over the return signal smoothing constant and therefore a hundred and fifty periods at the calibrated 0.02, to fifty short of the shock. Placed sixty short it would have opened ten periods inside the warm up, where a provider does not act on its own return at all.

The bound on the non-bank lifetime atom share is no longer a share of the panel. A share has to be chosen and nothing derives it; what the purpose derives is a test of the statistic the bound protects. Every seed outside the bound is dropped and the panel median of the order lifetime must not move, with a majority of the panel required inside so that there is a remainder to compare against. On the development panel 274 of 300 seeds sit inside the bound and the median is 2.0000 with the other 26 in or out.

The stale-results guard in the manuscript check was satisfied by a marker in a LaTeX comment, which reaches no page, while the table below it presented the figures as live. The check reads the text a reader meets, and it separates two situations that were one: a report produced by the branch of the other pair, which is what the paper reports and cannot be recomputed here, and a report produced by a superseded version of this calibration, which is withdrawn. The first is labelled in the text. The stored reports of the primary pair also declare the model that produced them and no measurement signature, so the comparison that was meant to detect staleness compared against nothing.

revision_history.reason: A third pair needed a channel this model did not have. The episode study reports, on both franc pairs, that where part of the provider population steps back the part that stays supplies more: in EUR/CHF the human traders inside the banks went from 38.8 to 68.4 per cent of provided volume while the bank algorithms fell from 54.1 to 25.1, and in USD/CHF the professional trading firms fell from 69.1 to 60.3 while the banks rose from 19.2 to 34.5. A dealer in this model could only quote or leave, so a sector small enough to supply a fifth of calm volume could never supply a third of the volume in a dislocation. The dealer now raises the depth it shows in proportion to the capacity that has gone, and the response is calibrated per pair. It is zero here, so this branch is the branch it was.
changes: mm_replacement_gain added, zero by default. At zero the term is absent, and the regression fingerprint of both the primary pair and this one is bit for bit what it was before the change, so the results of the two branches already frozen are reproduced and not revised.

The response multiplies the depth the dealer would actually show and not the running total behind it, which the volatility, funding and inventory terms can drive below zero. Applied to the running total it made a dealer supply less the more of the sector had gone, and the floor under depth hid it: every quote came out at the minimum whatever the response was.

Every frozen digest moves because the simulation source moved. The seeds, the targets and the calibration of this pair do not move, so the panel this protocol commits to is the same measurement it was.

revision_history.result: the order flow limb of an episode is connected to the flow accounting
revision_history.reason: The sweep that delivers an order flow shock executed through a pseudo trader straight against the book and never entered period_trades, which is what feeds observe_order_flow. The shock therefore removed liquidity and generated no signed flow, so the dealer constraints and the pool liquidity that respond to flow never saw it, and raising the size of the shock did nothing to the state it was meant to drive. Four of the five calm gates are measured on a scenario with no shock and do not move; the episode gates do.
changes: The sweep records what it filled in the shape a routed customer records a fill, and those fills join period_trades of the same period before the flow accounting runs.

A financing charge or balance sheet check that raises is still swallowed so that one firm cannot end a run, but it is counted now, so a period in which nothing landed is distinguishable from one in which everything did.
The help text of routing_cost_scale declared a default of four against an actual of one.

The comment on the constant product buy path now states why the invariant is preserved there and moves on the sell path, which is where the fee is taken from the base leg. An audit read the asymmetry as a defect; it is not, and the arithmetic is unchanged.

revision_history.result: the withdrawal threshold is recalibrated to the episode the connected sweep produces
revision_history.reason: Connecting the order flow sweep to the flow accounting under v5 strengthened the limb of the episode that drives the dealer constraint. The peak share of dealers withdrawn rose from 68 per cent to 80 and one seed of the three hundred evacuated the whole sector, which the no_full_dealer_evacuation check forbids and which leaves the capacity channel nothing to propagate. The threshold had been fitted against the weaker transmission and is refitted against the connected one.
changes: mm_withdraw_threshold on the episode preset moves from 4.0 to 4.15, the smallest step that closes the evacuation check while withdrawal remains the dominant mechanism at 60 per cent of dealers gone at the peak.

The size of the order flow shock was swept from 150 to 190 and is not the lever. The peak share withdrawn sits at 0.80 across that whole range and the crisis multiple moves only between 8.68 and 9.02, so the shock cannot be what is retuned and the threshold is what governs the outcome.
Every frozen digest moves because the simulation source moved. The seeds, the targets and the episode of this pair do not move.

revision_history.result: dead code is removed and the branch is refrozen on the smaller source
revision_history.reason: The same twenty four unreachable functions removed from the shared model reach this branch through the merge. The removal moves every digest and changes no behaviour.
changes: Seven hundred and three lines of unreachable code are gone from the shared source.
Behaviour is unchanged and the claim is measured. The regression panel on the same seed reproduces the predecessor exactly.
The holdout of the predecessor is not re-run. It was drawn once, under simulation_model_signature 85da8176550fe9e9, and that predecessor differs from this version only by the removal above.

final_inference_panel.status_note: Moved from 10042, which the revision history records as run and passed under v2. The field still named that block untouched, so the manifest offered a spent holdout as a virgin one.

lp_design.scenario_note: Moved from dealer_liquidity_crisis with the rest of the panel. The window moves from a hundred periods to a hundred and fifty because the least patient provider needs a hundred and forty five periods of sustained shortfall to complete an exit, so a provider result read over a hundred could not register a departure the episode caused.
